content.summary: The clinical guideline image discusses various imaging techniques used for evaluating carotid artery stenosis, a condition where the carotid arteries narrow, reducing blood flow to the brain and increasing stroke risk. Techniques mentioned include duplex ultrasonography, contrast-enhanced MR angiography, CT angiography, and Doppler ultrasound. Studies compare the effectiveness and accuracy of these methods in diagnosing carotid artery stenosis, with a focus on technical advancements and their clinical implications.
